title: SP-Rank: A Dataset for Ranked Preferences with Secondary Information
reasoning: The paper presents a dataset (SP-Rank) for benchmarking ranking algorithms using first-order and second-order signals. Its focus is on social choice theory, preference aggregation, and ground-truth recovery in objective or subjective domains like geography, movies, and paintings. It does not contain an evaluation or benchmark related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks.
